title: Every SaaS rebuilds the same 5 things.
lede: Before you write a single line of your actual product, you need:

items.title: Login and signup
items.text: So users can access your app.

items.title: Team invites and permissions
items.text: So customers can invite their coworkers.

withAiText: Your assistant improvises everything from scratch every session — different login flows, different billing logic, different bugs. It wastes hours (and your AI budget) debugging the same problems over and over.
withFonderieText: Your AI uses proven, tested building blocks. Same login flow every time. Same billing logic. Same security. You ship in a week and spend your time talking to customers.
